verdict.rationale: A runtime probe shows jo serves an OpenAPI 3.1 spec whose paths carry a version prefix (/v1/auth/*, /v1/users/*). That is the product's own versioned API surface. However, it is described as the app/bridge API with no developer program or public API keys, and nothing in the pack documents a versioning or deprecation policy. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, documented versioning/compatibility guarantees, a public developer API program, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: returned the backend's OpenAPI 3.1 spec ('"openapi":"3.1.0"', FastAPI, ~405 paths incl. /v1/auth/*, /v1/users/*, /v1/apple-messages/*)
